headline: 2001 order freezes US-held property of people found to threaten international peace efforts in the Western Balkans.
what_it_does: The order blocks, or freezes, property and assets under US control that belong to people seen as threatening international efforts to bring stability to the Western Balkans. Blocking orders like this generally bar Americans from doing business with the targeted people. No official summary was provided, so details such as who is named and how people are added are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: People and groups found to threaten stabilization efforts in the Western Balkans
who_it_affects.how: Any of their property or money held in the United States or by Americans can be frozen.
They would generally have to freeze the targeted people's assets and stop dealing with them.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed June 26, 2001; the exact start date is not stated in the provided material.
